subject.title: [Bug]: Gateway heap grows to 1073MB+ at idle on macOS, cron jobs fail silently under memory pressure (ref #86613, #86509)

question: Should this remain a separate macOS cron/failureAlert tracker, or should memory growth be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54155 while restart-aware cron alerting is tracked separately?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and broader open memory trackers, but this issue uniquely combines macOS launchd memory pressure, cron cluster failure, and in-process failureAlert delivery; the canonical owner and proof bar need maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Separate Tracker
options.body: Use this issue for the macOS launchd cron/failureAlert scenario until representative proof covers both memory stability and operator-visible failure reporting.

options.title: Fold Memory Into Broad Tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54155 canonical for heap/RSS growth and track restart-aware cron alerting in a narrower item.

options.title: Close After Partial Fixes
options.body: Treat the memory_search watcher and restart-accounting work as sufficient, accepting that QMD and in-process alert gaps remain unproven.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the macOS launchd cron/failureAlert scenario until representative proof covers both memory stability and operator-visible failure reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz reviewed the memory watcher fix and is already tied to the broader Gateway RSS profiling and representative-soak closure bar.
